successCriteria.description: knexfile.ts exports a Knex.Config with client 'pg', connection from DATABASE_URL env var, and migrations directory configured for TypeScript (.ts extension)
LeaveType interface in leave.model.ts has exactly: id (string), code (string), label (string), description (string), isActive (boolean), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date)

ILeaveTypeRepository interface declares: findAll() → Promise<LeaveType[]>, findById(id: string) → Promise<LeaveType | null>, findByCode(code: string) → Promise<LeaveType | null>, create(data: Omit<LeaveType, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) → Promise<LeaveType>

KnexLeaveTypeRepository implements ILeaveTypeRepository, accepts optional Knex instance in constructor, maps snake_case DB columns (is_active, created_at, updated_at) to camelCase model fields via private toLeaveType mapper

Migration 001_create_leave_types.ts: up creates leave_types table with uuid id PK (default gen_random_uuid()), code varchar(50) unique not null, label varchar(100) not null, description text not null default '', is_active boolean not null default true, created_at/updated_at timestamps; down drops the table

Unit tests mock Knex and verify: findAll filters is_active=true and returns mapped LeaveType[], findById returns type or null, findByCode returns type or null, create inserts with snake_case mapping and returns new type via returning('*')

constraints: GP-001: All database access must go through repository interfaces — KnexLeaveTypeRepository is the sole access point for leave_types table
HARNESS no-any rule: Use `Record<string, unknown>` with type guards instead of `any` — the toLeaveType mapper uses `row.id as string` pattern
HARNESS no-direct-db-outside-repository: No inline SQL/ORM calls outside the repository layer
outOfScope: LeaveRequest entity, LeaveRequestStatus enum, CreateLeaveRequestDto — deferred to Phase 2
LeaveBalance entity, UpdateLeaveBalanceDto — deferred to Phase 3
LeavePolicy entity — deferred to later phases (not in PLAN.md leave module phases)
Service layer, controllers, routes, and barrel export — deferred to Phases 4-5, 7-9
Seed data for leave types — deferred to Phase 6
Audit logging (GP-002) for leave type mutations — not required for this catalog-entity phase; audit applies to state-changing operations on LeaveRequest/LeaveBalance in later phases

ambiguities.description: Intent says "using the Knex instance from the existing src/shared/db/connection.ts" but connection.ts exports a pg.Pool, not a Knex instance. The implementation creates its own Knex instance (or accepts one via constructor). This is a resolved design decision in the existing code.
options: Keep current implementation: repository creates its own Knex instance with DATABASE_URL
Refactor connection.ts to export a Knex instance and have repository use it
Wrap the pg.Pool from connection.ts in a Knex instance inside the repository
